title: FractureSmp
description: The FractureSmp20 plugin introduces unique and powerful "Fractures" to your Minecraft SMP, granting players custom combat abilities and magical skills. To unlock these overpowered items, players must successfully complete specific, challenging background
body:
**FRACTURE SMP — OFFICIAL PLUGIN OVERVIEW**

_Plugin Made by - architback20

---




[Texture pack ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nZqroyssWynyRYyGmYwXU5LhmuMjrzlc/view?usp=drive_link)







**WHAT IS FRACTURE SMP?**

**Fracture SMP** is a custom progression-driven combat system designed to transform a regular Minecraft SMP into a high-stakes battlefield of power, strategy, and competition.

At its core are **9 legendary Fractures** — mystical artifacts forged from custom Echo Shards, each granting unique abilities capable of changing the outcome of battles.

Every Fracture unlocks exclusive powers, advanced combat mechanics, and distinctive playstyles that separate the strongest players from the rest.

---

**TASKS & GLOBAL SLOT SYSTEM**

Unlike ordinary custom items, Fractures cannot simply be crafted.

Players must complete massive server-wide milestones to earn the right to claim them.

**Challenge Requirements:**
• Survive **50 Pillager Raids**
• Defeat **25 Withers**
• Craft **1,000 TNT**
• Reach **Y-Level 1300**
• And many more difficult objectives

**Limited Global Slots:**
Every Fracture has a fixed number of available slots across the entire server.

• **Epic Fractures:** Usually limited to **1 owner**
• **Rare Fractures:** Usually limited to **2 owners**

Once all slots are claimed, no additional players can obtain that Fracture.

**Progress Tracking:**
`/checktask` → View personal progress
`/remaining` → Check available global Fracture slots

---

**COMBAT & ABILITIES**

Every Fracture features a powerful dual-ability system enhanced with custom particles, sounds, visual effects, and cooldown indicators.

**Primary Ability (F / Swap Hand):**
Activates an offensive or utility skill instantly.

Example:
**Villager Fracture** can create a powerful Gamble Domain with a chance to grant temporary invincibility.

**Secondary Ability (Shift + F):**
Triggers a defensive, crowd-control, or area-based ability.

Example:
**Singularity Fracture** creates a miniature black hole that pulls nearby entities inward.

**Unique Mechanics Include:**
• Mid-air double jumps
• Combo-based buffs
• Target locking
• Damage redirection
• Gravity manipulation
• Equipment preservation

---

**THE NINE FRACTURES**

**Decay (Rare)**
Masters of corruption and survival.
• Toxic clouds
• Resistance effects
• Area denial

**Singularity (Epic)**
Harness gravity.
• Teleportation
• Black hole abilities
• Battlefield control

**Air (Rare)**
Speed and mobility focused.
• Double jumps
• Wind blasts
• High-speed movement

**Thorns (Rare)**
Sustained damage pressure.
• Enemy tethering
• Bramble attacks
• Continuous damage

**Trapper (Epic)**
Explosive specialist.
• Bomb attachment
• Dripstone drills
• Area destruction

**Voodoo (Epic)**
Dark control abilities.
• Soul binding
• Damage redirection
• Ritual attacks

**Villager (Rare)**
Luck and economy-based combat.
• Emerald-powered skills
• Shockwaves
• Gamble mechanics

**Warrior (Rare)**
Pure combat mastery.
• Combo rewards
• Strength boosts
• Speed enhancements
• Advanced arrows

**Mend (Epic)**
Support and preservation.
• Instant repairs
• Equipment protection
• Hotbar control

---

**PLAYER COMMANDS**

Players may only equip **one Fracture at a time**.

`/withdraw` → Safely remove and store your active Fracture

**Warrior Settings:**
`/warrior mob on`
`/warrior mob off`

---

**ADMIN COMMANDS**

`/fracture` → Access all Fractures
`/cooldown` → Reset ability cooldowns
`/complete` → Complete tasks instantly

---

**FINAL NOTE**

Only the fastest players will complete the challenges.
Only the strongest players will secure a Fracture.
Only the most skilled players will master its power.

**COMPETE. CLAIM. DOMINATE.**

**The race for the Fractures has begun.**
